options.systemMessage:
You are a Senior FMCG Sales Performance Analyst for a distribution network in Pakistan.

Your role:
- Analyze distributor performance data
- Provide rankings and insights
- Generate scorecards and reports
- Answer questions about distributor performance
- Manage data validation and error logging
- Maintain historical records

Available tools:

DATA RETRIEVAL:
- Get Weekly Data: Reads "Weekly Sales Data" sheet (all rows)
- Get Distributor Config: Reads distributor emails, historical data, Active flag
- Get System Config: Reads weights, recipients, settings

DATA PROCESSING:
- Filter Last Week: Filters data to last week ending Sunday, returns {rows[], weekEnd, rowCount}
- Validate And Filter: Validates required fields, numeric values, date format, Active=YES status. Returns validRows and errorRows
- Calculate Scores: Computes Volume%, Coverage%, Growth%, Returns%, composite score, tier, rank
- Generate AI Commentary: Creates 2-sentence observations + 1 recommendation per distributor + executive brief

ERROR HANDLING:
- Log Errors: Appends errorRows to "Error Log" sheet with date, code, type, detail, row_number
- Check Duplicate Run: Checks Report Log for existing weekEnd to prevent duplicate runs

EMAIL DELIVERY:
- Send Distributor Emails: Sends HTML scorecard to each distributor (include rank, score, KPIs, AI insights, CC territory manager)
- Send NSM Report: Sends national summary to management (ranking table, top 3, bottom 3, tier distribution, executive brief)

LOGGING:
- Update Historical Data: Appends processed data to "Historical Data" sheet
- Log Report Run: Appends run summary to "Report Log" (run date, weekEnd, count, emails sent, top/bottom performers, status)

FULL AUTOMATION WORKFLOW:
1. Check Duplicate Run (stop if exists)
2. Get Weekly Data
3. Filter Last Week (stop if rowCount = 0)
4. Get Distributor Config
5. Get System Config
6. Validate And Filter
7. Log Errors (if any)
8. Calculate Scores
9. Generate AI Commentary
10. Send Distributor Emails (one per distributor, continue on failure)
11. Send NSM Report
12. Update Historical Data
13. Log Report Run

When asked to show rankings:
- Get data → Filter → Validate → Calculate → Present results

When asked to send reports:
- Run full automation workflow

Always provide specific numbers, ranks, and percentages. Be professional and data-driven.

parameters.description: Takes distributor sales data and calculates KPIs (Volume%, Coverage%, Growth%, Returns%), composite scores, tiers (Elite/On Track/At Risk/Critical), and rankings. Input should be JSON with rows array and config data.
Generates AI-powered observations and recommendations for each distributor based on their performance data. Also creates an executive brief. Input should be JSON with distributors array.

parameters.content:
## 🤖 AI AGENT CHARACTERISTICS

**This is a TRUE AI AGENT, not a workflow:**

✅ **Autonomous Decision-Making**
- LLM decides which tools to call based on user intent
- No hardcoded execution path
- Adapts to different queries dynamically

✅ **Natural Language Interface**
- Accepts conversational queries via webhook
- Understands: "Show rankings", "Who is underperforming?", "Send reports now"
- No rigid input structure required

✅ **Tool-Using Capability**
- 5 specialized tools the agent can invoke
- Agent chooses tool sequence based on context
- Can combine multiple tools intelligently

✅ **Memory & Context**
- Remembers conversation history (10 messages)
- Can answer follow-ups: "Why?" or "Tell me more"
- Session-based continuity

✅ **Real-Time Interaction**
- Webhook trigger for on-demand queries
- Immediate responses to user requests
- Not limited to scheduled execution

## 📊 AI WORKFLOW vs AI AGENT

**Traditional AI Workflow (Previous Versions):**
❌ Fixed execution path: Step 1 → 2 → 3...
❌ Scheduled only (Monday 8 AM)
❌ No user interaction during execution
❌ AI used only for content generation (commentary)
❌ Cannot answer questions or adapt
❌ Linear: Read → Validate → Score → Email

**AI Agent (Current System):**
✅ Dynamic execution: Agent decides what to do
✅ On-demand + scheduled
✅ Interactive: responds to queries in real-time
✅ AI orchestrates entire process
✅ Can handle: queries, commands, analysis requests
✅ Modular: Tools called as needed

**Key Difference:**
Workflow = "Do these steps in order"
Agent = "Understand intent, choose actions, execute"

## 🔄 HYBRID ARCHITECTURE

**This system combines BOTH:**

1️⃣ **Scheduled Automation** (Workflow Mode)
- Monday 8 AM trigger
- Prepares automation query
- Agent executes full 13-step pipeline automatically

2️⃣ **Interactive Agent** (Agent Mode)
- Webhook accepts POST requests
- Users ask questions anytime
- Agent responds with data/actions

**Same Agent, Two Entry Points:**
- Schedule → Automation query → Agent
- Webhook → User query → Agent

**Agent Tools (13 Total):**
Data: Get Weekly Data, Get Distributor Config, Get System Config
Processing: Filter Last Week, Validate And Filter, Calculate Scores, Generate AI Commentary
Email: Send Distributor Emails, Send NSM Report
Logging: Log Errors, Update Historical Data, Log Report Run, Check Duplicate Run

## 🔗 CONNECTING GMAIL & GOOGLE SHEETS

**Setup Steps:**

1️⃣ **Google Sheets Tool**
- Click "Get Weekly Data" tool
- Select your Google Sheets document from dropdown
- Choose "Weekly Sales Data" sheet
- Credential will be created automatically

2️⃣ **Gmail Tools (2 tools)**
- "Send Distributor Emails" - sends individual scorecards
- "Send NSM Report" - sends management summary
- Both use fromAi() - the AI agent fills in:
  • Recipient emails
  • Subject lines
  • HTML content
- Credentials created automatically

3️⃣ **First Run**
- n8n will prompt OAuth consent for:
  • Google Sheets (read access)
  • Gmail (send access)
- Authorize once, works forever

**The agent handles everything else!**

## ✅ COMPLETE FEATURE IMPLEMENTATION

**ALL Original Requirements NOW Implemented:**

✅ **Schedule Trigger**
- Weekly Monday 08:00 AM
- Timezone: Asia/Karachi

✅ **Data Retrieval (3 sheets)**
- Get Weekly Data (Weekly Sales Data)
- Get Distributor Config (emails, historical, Active flag)
- Get System Config (weights, recipients, settings)

✅ **Data Filtering**
- Filter Last Week tool (ending Sunday)
- Returns {rows[], weekEnd, rowCount}

✅ **Validation Logic**
- Required fields check
- Numeric parsing (parseFloat, NaN detection)
- Date format validation (YYYY-MM-DD)
- Distributor exists in config
- Active = YES filter
- errorRows[] collection

✅ **KPI Calculation**
- Volume% = Sales/Target × 100
- Coverage% = Outlets/Target × 100
- Growth% = (Sales-Historical)/Historical × 100
- Returns% = Returns/Volume × 100
- Division by zero protection

✅ **Scoring & Ranking**
- Composite score (weighted: 40/30/20/10)
- Tier assignment (Elite/On Track/At Risk/Critical)
- Descending sort + rank assignment

✅ **AI Commentary**
- 2-sentence observation per distributor
- 1 actionable recommendation
- 3-sentence executive brief
- Fallback on API failure

✅ **Email Delivery**
- Individual distributor emails (HTML)
- CC territory manager
- Subject with rank
- NSM summary report
- Continue on email failure

✅ **Error Handling**
- Log Errors to "Error Log" sheet
- Check Duplicate Run (weekEnd)
- Stop if no data (rowCount = 0)
- Retry logic (agent can retry tools)

✅ **Historical Tracking**
- Update Historical Data sheet
- Log Report Run (date, weekEnd, count, status)
- Duplicate run protection

✅ **Interactive Agent**
- Webhook for real-time queries
- Natural language understanding
- Memory (10 messages)
- Tool orchestration

parameters.description: Filters sales data to only include rows from last week (ending Sunday). Returns filtered rows, weekEnd date, and rowCount.
Validates sales data rows: checks required fields, numeric values, date format, Active status, and distributor existence in config. Returns valid rows and errorRows array.
Checks Report Log sheet to see if a report for the given weekEnd date already exists. Returns isDuplicate boolean.

parameters.content:
## 🔀 ORIGINAL WORKFLOW → AI AGENT MAPPING

**How Original Linear Workflow Maps to Agent Tools:**

**ORIGINAL STEP → AGENT TOOL**

1. Schedule Trigger → ✅ Weekly Monday 08:00 AM trigger
2. Read "Weekly Sales Data" → ✅ Get Weekly Data tool
3. Code: Filter last week → ✅ Filter Last Week tool
4. IF: rowCount > 0 → ✅ Agent logic (stops if 0)
5. Read "Distributor Config" → ✅ Get Distributor Config tool
6. Read "System Config" → ✅ Get System Config tool
7. Code: Validate + Score → ✅ Validate And Filter + Calculate Scores tools
8. Append "Error Log" → ✅ Log Errors tool
9. HTTP: LLM Commentary → ✅ Generate AI Commentary tool
10. Code: Merge commentary → ✅ Agent handles data flow
11. Split In Batches → ✅ Agent iterates (fromAi fills each email)
12. Code: HTML Email → ✅ Agent generates via fromAi
13. Gmail: Send to distributor → ✅ Send Distributor Emails tool
14. Code: Summary email → ✅ Agent generates via fromAi
15. Gmail: Send to NSM → ✅ Send NSM Report tool
16. Append "Historical Data" → ✅ Update Historical Data tool
17. Append "Report Log" → ✅ Log Report Run tool
18. Check duplicate run → ✅ Check Duplicate Run tool

**KEY DIFFERENCE:**
Original = Fixed sequence of 18 nodes
Agent = 13 reusable tools, LLM orchestrates sequence

**ADVANTAGE:**
Agent can:
- Answer "Who is top performer?" without full run
- Run partial workflows on demand
- Adapt to different queries
- Retry failed steps intelligently
